subject.title: fix(commands): re-check owner for cross-channel /allowlist writes

question: Should channel-derived owners be limited to their exact origin account for `/allowlist` writes, with only configured global owners and gateway admins allowed across account scopes?
rationale: Account-specific allowlists participate in owner authorization, so treating ownership as account-wide would be an intentional security contract rather than an implementation detail.

options.title: Scope by channel and account
options.body: Reauthorize every non-global owner when either the normalized target channel or target account differs from the origin scope.

options.title: Make channel ownership account-wide
options.body: Allow one account's owner to mutate every account under that channel, with explicit documentation and security tests.

recommendation.title: Scope by channel and account
recommendation.body: Reauthorize every non-global owner when either the normalized target channel or target account differs from the origin scope.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work spans command authorization, account-aware config-write policy, and the affected handler.
